MIND. [1] [Lac. ac.]
Great discouragement. θ Pregnancy.
Memory affected ; cannot remember a thing an hour after it has happened.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Lac. ac.]
Pain in head and back all night.
Severe pain in forehead and all through head, with chill.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Lac. ac.]
Hyperesthesia of retina, steady aching in and behind eyeball.
Pupils dilated.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Lac. ac.]
Great sensitiveness of smell.
Epistaxis every morning ; greenish yellow stools, with tenesmus.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Lac. ac.]
Congestion of blood to face and head.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Lac. ac.]
Tongue dry, parched, sticky. θ Diabetes mellitus.
Thick white coating on tongue.
Yellow coating on tongue, with bad taste in morning.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Lac. ac.]
Very sore mouth ; canker sores.
Child had been fretting forty days, cried on taking any food into its mouth, which was inflamed, and tongue and lips studded with little white blisters with a red base.
Mouth very dry ; roof dry, feels burnt.
Copious salivation. θ Pregnancy.
Much saliva in mouth tasting salty.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Lac. ac.]
Great dryness of throat, with hoarseness and dry cough.
Fulness in throat, which keeps him swallowing frothy mucus ; lump or fulness feels like a small puff ball ; not > by swallowing.
Constricted feeling low down in throat, with slight nausea.
Sensation of plug in throat.
Sense of constriction in throat ; rough and dry.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Lac. ac.]
Voracious appetite and great thirst. θ Diabetes mellitus.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Lac. ac.]
Uneasiness in stomach after food and drink. θ Diabetes mellitus.
Food sours ; eructations ; flatus ; indifference to food.
After eating : nausea ; retching, waterbrash, uneasy in stomach. θ Diabetes.
Sensation as if all food was lodged under upper end of sternum, which oppresses and distresses for hours.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Lac. ac.]
Waterbrash, with continued profuse discharge of saliva.
Eructations of hot, acrid fluid, which burns from stomach to throat.
Nausea : after getting up in morning ; like seasickness, with headache ; with pain through right eye ; with cough ; followed by backache ; after eating, copious saliva (pregnancy) ; < from any motion ; constant.
Morning sickness, particularly in pale, anemic women, who lose much blood during menses.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Lac. ac.]
Feeling of emptiness and sinking at stomach. θ Diabetes mellitus.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Lac. ac.]
Pain over crest of left ilium, extending forward.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Lac. ac.]
Bowels very costive, stool once a week, feces hard, black. θ Diabetes mellitus.
Greenish yellow stools with tenesmus. θ Epistaxis.
Soft, mushy stool.
Aching pain in anus.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Lac. ac.]
Urine in large quantities, passed frequently. θ Diabetes.
Urine deep brownish red, with much reddish sediment.
Urinates frequently, day and night ; attempt to retain it causes pain.
Voracious appetite ; great thirst ; frequent and profuse saccharine urine ; skin harsh and dry, no sweat ; bowels very costive, stool once a week, feces hard, black ; tongue dry, parched, sticky ; feeling of emptiness and sinking at stomach ; debility ; chilliness, especially extremities ; weariness in extremities ; aversion to exercise ; uneasiness in stomach after food and drink. θ Diabetes.
Man, æt. 62, phlegmatic, dark complexion, dark hair and eyes, had dropsy several times ; great weakness, restless during night ; severe aching pains in feet and legs, preventing sleep ; frequent voiding of foamy, strong smelling, dark urine ; quantity from eighteen to twenty pounds in twenty-four hours ; in morning urine contained a large amount of salt, in evening a large excess of sugar ; violent thirst day and night ; unable to walk further than a few rods. θ Diabetes mellitus.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Lac. ac.]
Aching pain in region of right ovary, < by rapid walking or exercise.
Leucorrhœa : stains yellow as saffron ; was stopped, nasal catarrh ensued.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Lac. ac.]
During pregnancy : morning sickness ; salivation ; nausea and vomiting.
Morning sickness in pale, anemic women, who lose large quantities of blood during menses, which usually last from five to eight days.
Nausea and vomiting of sour substances ; sour taste ; no desire for breakfast, food seems to come almost up into mouth ; faintness in stomach ; diarrhœa. θ Pregnancy.
Waterbrash of hot sour fluid ; hot, acrid eructations, which burn from stomach to mouth ; mouth full of water ; burning in stomach ; nausea > by breakfast ; gone sensation low down in stomach. θ Pregnancy.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Lac. ac.]
Great dryness, with hoarseness and dry cough ; dryness and rawness extending to larynx ; rim of glottis particularly affected.
Aphonia, with dryness of glottis.
Hoarse, hard, dry cough, sensation of dryness of epiglottis, with spasmodic contractive sensation.
Great dryness of throat, hoarseness and dry cough.
Dryness, scratching and burning in throat ; tearing in larynx and trachea, with hoarseness ; difficult expectoration of grey tasteless mucus, or so tough that air can hardly pass through it ; horrible dreams of abysses, and restless sleep ; croup sound not heard. θ Croup.
   

COUGH. [27] [Lac. ac.]
Hoarse, hard, dry cough ; dry sensation of glottis, with spasmodic contractive sensation ; hoarse, sensitive to cold air.
Constant cough, < in Spring and Fall, with foot sweats.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Lac. ac.]
Aching and sore pain across small of back.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Lac. ac.]
Profuse inoffensive sweating of feet.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Lac. ac.]
Sweat acrid and profuse ; urine clear or high colored and frequent, profuse or scanty ; rheumatic soreness in muscles of chest, back and extremities ; rheumatic inflammation of elbows, knees and small joints of upper and lower extremities, < at night and from motion ; fever, with headache and flushes of heat.
   

NERVES. [36] [Lac. ac.]
Debility, weariness of limbs, aversion to exercise. θ Diabetes mellitus.
Intermittent hysteria ; nauseated in morning when swallowing, and gets < until 9 A. M., when she vomits large quantities of tough phlegm, sometimes had to remove it with finger, lasting till 9 P. M.
   

FEVER. [40] [Lac. ac.]
Chilly, mostly on limbs.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Lac. ac.]
Swelling of bone.
Chronic osteitis ; exostosis, especially of thighs ; chicken breast.
Articular rheumatism ; dissolves many tissues.
Kidney affections ; croup ; diphtheria ; morning sickness of pregnancy ; emaciation ; rheumatism.
   

SKIN. [46] [Lac. ac.]
Skin hard and dry, no sweat. θ Diabetes mellitus.
Skin harsh, dry, no sweat. θ Diabetes mellitus.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Lac. ac.]
Anemic, pale women.
